hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -Eeuo pipefail shopt -s extglob umask 077
log() { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')" "$*" }
fail() { log "ERROR: $*" >&2 exit 255 }
require_command() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "Required command not found: $1" }
for command_name in aws csvcut csvformat split flock java stat; do require_command "$command_name" done
# Required Jenkins parameter/environment variable. : "${managed_inputs:?managed_inputs must contain the S3 URI for Managed_Inputs.csv}"
ROLE_ARN="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" ROLE_DURATION_SECONDS="${ROLE_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}" AWS_REGION="${AWS_REGION:-${AWS_DEFAULT_REGION:-us-east-1}}" export AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION="$AWS_REGION"
S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}"
# Aggressive but bounded defaults for r5.4xlarge (16 vCPU / 128 GiB). # Six AWS CLI processes x 24 transfer workers = up to 144 S3 requests in flight. DOWNLOAD_WORKERS="${DOWNLOAD_WORKERS:-6}" S3_REQUESTS_PER_PROCESS="${S3_REQUESTS_PER_PROCESS:-24}" S3_MULTIPART_CHUNK_SIZE="${S3_MULTIPART_CHUNK_SIZE:-32MB}" S3_IO_CHUNK_SIZE="${S3_IO_CHUNK_SIZE:-1MB}" SPLIT_SIZE="${SPLIT_SIZE:-250MB}" SPLIT_SUFFIX_LENGTH="${SPLIT_SUFFIX_LENGTH:-4}"
HEAP_GB="${HEAP_GB:-88}" INITIAL_HEAP_GB="${INITIAL_HEAP_GB:-44}" JAVA_PARALLELISM="${JAVA_PARALLELISM:-14}"
# Put this on the persistent Jenkins XFS volume, not ephemeral workspace storage. CACHE_ROOT="${S3_CACHE_ROOT:-${JENKINS_HOME:-$PWD}/caches/dbgap-allconcepts}" LOCK_ROOT="$CACHE_ROOT/.locks" STATE_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/dbgap-etl.XXXXXX")" FAILURE_MARKER="$STATE_DIR/background-job-failed" ETL_AWS_CONFIG=""
cleanup() { unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN || true [[ -z "$ETL_AWS_CONFIG" ]] || rm -f "$ETL_AWS_CONFIG" rm -rf "$STATE_DIR" } trap cleanup EXIT trap 'rc=$?; log "Command failed at line $LINENO with exit code $rc" >&2' ERR
mkdir -p "$CACHE_ROOT" "$LOCK_ROOT"
# Clean all working directories correctly. The original script crossed # completed/processing and only removed regular files. for directory in beforeRemoval data completed processing; do mkdir -p "$directory" find "$directory" -mindepth 1 -delete done
configure_s3_cli() { local original_config="${AWS_CONFIG_FILE:-$HOME/.aws/config}" ETL_AWS_CONFIG="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/aws-etl-config.XXXXXX")"
if [[ -f "$original_config" ]]; then cp "$original_config" "$ETL_AWS_CONFIG" fi
export AWS_CONFIG_FILE="$ETL_AWS_CONFIG" export AWS_RETRY_MODE="standard" export AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS="10"
aws configure set default.region "$AWS_REGION" aws configure set default.s3.max_concurrent_requests "$S3_REQUESTS_PER_PROCESS" aws configure set default.s3.max_queue_size 10000 aws configure set default.s3.multipart_threshold "$S3_MULTIPART_CHUNK_SIZE" aws configure set default.s3.multipart_chunksize "$S3_MULTIPART_CHUNK_SIZE" aws configure set default.s3.io_chunksize "$S3_IO_CHUNK_SIZE" }
assume_role() { local session_name credentials session_name="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-dbgap-etl-${BUILD_NUMBER:-manual}-$$}" session_name="${session_name//[^[:alnum:]+=,.@_-]/-}" session_name="${session_name:0:64}"
credentials="$({ aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$ROLE_DURATION_SECONDS" \ --role-arn "$ROLE_ARN" \ --role-session-name "$session_name" \ --query 'Credentials.[AccessKeyId,SecretAccessKey,SessionToken]' \ --output text })" || fail "Unable to assume $ROLE_ARN"
read -r AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN <<<"$credentials" [[ -n "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" && -n "$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" && -n "$AWS_SESSION_TOKEN" ]] \ || fail "AssumeRole returned incomplete credentials"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN }
release_assumed_role() { unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN }
normalize_flag() { local value="$1" value="${value##+([[:space:]])}" value="${value%%+([[:space:]])}" printf '%s' "${value,,}" }
safe_lock_name() { local value="$1" printf '%s' "${value//[^[:alnum:]_.-]/_}" }
parse_s3_uri() { local uri="$1" remainder [[ "$uri" == s3://*/* ]] || fail "Invalid S3 URI: $uri" remainder="${uri#s3://}" S3_URI_BUCKET="${remainder%%/*}" S3_URI_KEY="${remainder#*/}" }
# Caller must hold the object's lock. Cache replacement is atomic and the # cached object is reused only when URI, size, ETag, LastModified, and VersionId match. cache_fetch_unlocked() { local uri="$1" cache_file="$2" local metadata_file="${cache_file}.metadata" local remote_metadata remote_size remote_etag remote_modified remote_version local fingerprint cached_fingerprint="" actual_size temp_file temp_metadata
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$cache_file")" parse_s3_uri "$uri"
remote_metadata="$(aws s3api head-object \ --bucket "$S3_URI_BUCKET" \ --key "$S3_URI_KEY" \ --query '[ContentLength,ETag,LastModified,VersionId]' \ --output text)" || fail "Unable to inspect $uri"
read -r remote_size remote_etag remote_modified remote_version <<<"$remote_metadata" [[ "$remote_size" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || fail "Invalid ContentLength returned for $uri"
fingerprint="$uri|$remote_size|$remote_etag|$remote_modified|$remote_version" [[ ! -f "$metadata_file" ]] || cached_fingerprint="$(<"$metadata_file")"
if [[ -f "$cache_file" && "$cached_fingerprint" == "$fingerprint" ]]; then actual_size="$(stat -c '%s' "$cache_file")" if [[ "$actual_size" == "$remote_size" ]]; then log "S3 cache hit: $uri" return 0 fi log "Cache size mismatch; refreshing: $uri" else log "S3 cache miss/changed object: $uri" fi
temp_file="${cache_file}.partial.${BUILD_NUMBER:-manual}.$$" temp_metadata="${metadata_file}.partial.${BUILD_NUMBER:-manual}.$$" rm -f "$temp_file" "$temp_metadata"
if ! aws s3 cp "$uri" "$temp_file" --no-progress --only-show-errors; then rm -f "$temp_file" "$temp_metadata" fail "Download failed: $uri" fi
actual_size="$(stat -c '%s' "$temp_file")" if [[ "$actual_size" != "$remote_size" ]]; then rm -f "$temp_file" "$temp_metadata" fail "Downloaded size mismatch for $uri: expected=$remote_size actual=$actual_size" fi
printf '%s\n' "$fingerprint" >"$temp_metadata" mv -f "$temp_file" "$cache_file" mv -f "$temp_metadata" "$metadata_file" }
clear_local_study_files() { local study_id_lower="$1" find beforeRemoval -maxdepth 1 -type f \ -name "${study_id_lower}_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv*" \ -delete find data -maxdepth 1 -type f \ -name "${study_id_lower}.*.csv" \ -delete }
clear_study_cache_and_stage() { local study_id_lower="$1" lock_name lock_name="$(safe_lock_name "study-$study_id_lower")"
clear_local_study_files "$study_id_lower"
( flock -x 9 rm -rf "$CACHE_ROOT/studies/$study_id_lower" log "Cleared cache because study is not ready: $study_id_lower" ) 9>"$LOCK_ROOT/$lock_name.lock" }
study_ehr_uri() { case "$1" in phs003463) printf 's3://%s/recover_adult/completed/phs003463/phs003463_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.ehr.csv' "$S3_BUCKET" ;; phs003461) printf 's3://%s/recover_pediatrics/completed/phs003461/phs003461_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.ehr.csv' "$S3_BUCKET" ;; *) return 1 ;; esac }
process_ready_study() { local abbreviated_name="$1" study_id="$2" local abbreviated_lower="${abbreviated_name,,}" local study_id_lower="${study_id,,}" local cache_dir="$CACHE_ROOT/studies/$study_id_lower" local clinical_cache="$cache_dir/clinical.csv" local ehr_cache="$cache_dir/ehr.csv" local clinical_uri ehr_uri="" local output_prefix lock_name
clinical_uri="s3://$S3_BUCKET/$abbreviated_lower/completed/$study_id/${study_id_lower}_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv" output_prefix="beforeRemoval/${study_id_lower}_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv" lock_name="$(safe_lock_name "study-$study_id_lower")"
clear_local_study_files "$study_id_lower"
# Hold the study lock through cache validation and split. This prevents a # concurrent build with flag=N from deleting the cache while it is being read. ( flock -x 9
cache_fetch_unlocked "$clinical_uri" "$clinical_cache"
if ehr_uri="$(study_ehr_uri "$study_id_lower")"; then cache_fetch_unlocked "$ehr_uri" "$ehr_cache" fi
split \ --numeric-suffixes=0 \ --suffix-length="$SPLIT_SUFFIX_LENGTH" \ --line-bytes="$SPLIT_SIZE" \ "$clinical_cache" \ "$output_prefix"
# Preserve the existing stop-gap semantics without risking a collision # with clinical split parts. The merge JAR sees this as another input chunk. if [[ -n "$ehr_uri" ]]; then cp --reflink=auto "$ehr_cache" "${output_prefix}9999" fi ) 9>"$LOCK_ROOT/$lock_name.lock"
compgen -G "${output_prefix}*" >/dev/null \ || fail "No split output produced for ready study $abbreviated_name $study_id"
log "Ready study staged from cache/S3 and split: $study_id" }
process_fixed_input() { local name="$1" uri="$2" destination="$3" local lock_name cache_file lock_name="$(safe_lock_name "fixed-$name")" cache_file="$CACHE_ROOT/fixed/$name"
( flock -x 9 cache_fetch_unlocked "$uri" "$cache_file" rm -f "$destination" cp --reflink=auto "$cache_file" "$destination" ) 9>"$LOCK_ROOT/$lock_name.lock"
[[ -s "$destination" ]] || fail "Fixed input is missing or empty: $destination" log "Fixed input staged: $name" }
active_job_count() { jobs -rp | wc -l }
wait_for_job_slot() { while (( $(active_job_count) >= DOWNLOAD_WORKERS )); do if ! wait -n; then : # The child records failure in FAILURE_MARKER. fi done }
launch_job() { local label="$1" shift wait_for_job_slot
( trap 'rc=$?; if (( rc != 0 )); then printf "%s\n" "$label" >>"$FAILURE_MARKER"; fi' EXIT "$@" ) & }
wait_for_all_jobs() { while (( $(active_job_count) > 0 )); do if ! wait -n; then : # Failure is reported after all active transfers are reaped. fi done
if [[ -f "$FAILURE_MARKER" ]]; then log "Failed background jobs:" >&2 sort -u "$FAILURE_MARKER" >&2 exit 255 fi }
configure_s3_cli assume_role
log "Downloading control files" aws s3 cp "$managed_inputs" Managed_Inputs.csv --no-progress --only-show-errors aws s3 cp \ "s3://$S3_BUCKET/general/data/metadata_new_search.json" \ metadata_new_search.json \ --no-progress \ --only-show-errors
[[ -s Managed_Inputs.csv ]] || fail "Managed_Inputs.csv is missing or empty" [[ -s metadata_new_search.json ]] || fail "metadata_new_search.json is missing or empty"
# csvkit handles quoted commas correctly; plain IFS=',' does not. csvcut \ -c "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed" \ Managed_Inputs.csv \ | csvformat -T \ >inputs.tsv
# Fail on duplicate study IDs so Yes/No rows cannot race or produce nondeterministic cache state. declare -A seen_studies=()
while IFS=$'\t' read -r abbreviated_name study_id study_type data_ready data_processed; do [[ -n "$study_id" ]] || continue
study_id="${study_id##+([[:space:]])}" study_id="${study_id%%+([[:space:]])}" abbreviated_name="${abbreviated_name##+([[:space:]])}" abbreviated_name="${abbreviated_name%%+([[:space:]])}"
study_id_lower="${study_id,,}" [[ -z "${seen_studies[$study_id_lower]:-}" ]] \ || fail "Duplicate Study Identifier in Managed_Inputs.csv: $study_id" seen_studies[$study_id_lower]=1
ready_flag="$(normalize_flag "$data_ready")" case "$ready_flag" in yes|y) launch_job "$study_id" process_ready_study "$abbreviated_name" "$study_id" ;; *) # This includes N/No, blank, and unexpected values. Only an explicit Yes can # populate or reuse cache and enter beforeRemoval. clear_study_cache_and_stage "$study_id_lower" log "$abbreviated_name ($study_id) marked not ready: flag='$data_ready'" ;; esac done < <(tail -n +2 inputs.tsv)
launch_job "HRMN" process_fixed_input \ "HRMN_allConcepts.csv" \ "s3://$S3_BUCKET/hrmn/completed/HRMN_allConcepts.csv" \ "beforeRemoval/HRMN_allConcepts.csv"
launch_job "GLOBAL" process_fixed_input \ "GLOBAL_allConcepts_merged.csv" \ "s3://$S3_BUCKET/general/completed/GLOBAL_allConcepts_merged.csv" \ "beforeRemoval/GLOBAL_allConcepts.csv"
wait_for_all_jobs
release_assumed_role
CORES="$(nproc)" (( JAVA_PARALLELISM <= CORES )) || JAVA_PARALLELISM="$CORES" (( JAVA_PARALLELISM >= 4 )) || JAVA_PARALLELISM=4
log "Running RemoveConsentZeroPatients: parallelism=$JAVA_PARALLELISM cores=$CORES heap=${HEAP_GB}g" java \ "-Xms${INITIAL_HEAP_GB}g" \ "-Xmx${HEAP_GB}g" \ -DmaximumPoolSize="$JAVA_PARALLELISM" \ -Djava.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool.common.parallelism="$JAVA_PARALLELISM" \ -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError \ -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError \ -XX:HeapDumpPath=./remove-consent-oom-heapdump.hprof \ -Xlog:gc*,safepoint:file=remove-consent-gc.log:time,level,tags \ -jar jars/RemoveConsentZeroPatients.jar
log "Running DbGapDataMerge: heap=${HEAP_GB}g" java \ "-Xms${INITIAL_HEAP_GB}g" \ "-Xmx${HEAP_GB}g" \ -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError \ -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError \ -XX:HeapDumpPath=./merge-oom-heapdump.hprof \ -Xlog:gc*,safepoint:file=merge-gc.log:time,level,tags \ -jar jars/DbGapDataMerge.jar
[[ -s completed/allConcepts.csv ]] || fail "DbGapDataMerge did not produce completed/allConcepts.csv"
# The Java work can exceed the role session, so obtain fresh credentials only for upload. assume_role
log "Uploading completed/allConcepts.csv" aws s3 cp \ completed/allConcepts.csv \ "s3://$S3_BUCKET/general/completed/allConcepts_data_analyzer.csv" \ --no-progress \ --only-show-errors
release_assumed_role log "ETL job completed successfully"
